name: MARKERLIGHTS
text: Markerlight tokens belong to the Pathfinder player and sit on enemy operatives (up to 4 each). Whenever one of your Pathfinders shoots with a weapon from its own datacard (not the fusion grenade), its target's tokens give it extra rules, cumulatively: 1 token, Saturate and Balanced; 2, Hit of its ranged weapons improved by 1 but never better than 3+; 3, the target cannot be obscured; 4, Seek Light; 5, Seek. Once during each of its own activations, an enemy with your tokens that Dashes, Charges, Falls Back or Repositions loses one.

name: MARKERLIGHT
text: Pick an enemy operative this operative can see; it gains one of your Markerlight tokens, to a maximum of 4. Not in an enemy control range. If this operative also Shoots (not Guard) in the same activation, both actions must pick the same target. The MB3 Recon Drone is exempt from that link.

name: MARKERLIGHT
text: Pick an enemy operative this operative can see; it gains one of your Markerlight tokens, to a maximum of 4. A Shas'la can do this even in an enemy control range (Fearless on the Frontline). If it also Shoots (not Guard) in the same activation, both actions must pick the same target.

name: Art of War
text: The Shas'ui, while in the killzone, can use the ART OF WAR strategic gambit once per turning point for no CP. Pick Mont'ka (friendly Pathfinders get +1 inch of Move) or Kauyon (friendly Pathfinders with a Conceal order may perform one free Markerlight in their activation) until the end of the turning point. Each option can be picked only once per battle.

name: Veteran
text: In a turning point where you used Art of War, when the Blooded activates you may swap the option for this operative alone, for that activation only: Kauyon instead of Mont'ka, or the Mont'ka Move bonus instead of Kauyon. This is not a pick of that option.

name: Grenadier Specialist
text: Can use frag and krak grenades, once each, with their Hit improved by 1 (to 3+). These uses are separate from any grenades the team picked as equipment.

name: SIGNAL
text: Choose a different friendly Pathfinder (drones included) that this operative can see within 6 inches: it has +1 APL until its next activation is over. Cannot be used while an enemy has this operative in its control range.

name: Drone Controller
text: As long as this operative is on the table, your Pathfinder drones move 2 inches further and Saviour Protocols is free to use.

name: REMOTE PILOT
text: The controller takes direct charge of a friendly Pathfinder drone, which acts at once with one free action of any kind (its Drone restrictions are lifted for it) and travels at most 2 inches doing so. Unavailable in an enemy control range. Repeatable within the activation, though a given drone never repeats the same free action in it.

name: Inertial Dampener
text: Penalties to the Hit stat of this operative's marksman rail rifle are ignored, whatever profile it uses.

name: Medic!
text: Once per turning point, at the first moment another friendly non-drone Pathfinder this operative can see within 3 inches is about to go down, the medic steps in (provided neither of them has an enemy in control range): the casualty stays in play on 1 wound and nothing can take it down for the rest of that action. Once the action is over it may make a free Dash that finishes in the medic's control range. Each of the two then has -1 APL until its next activation is over, and if this happened during the casualty's own activation, that activation stops. Not available while the medic is down, or when the medic is itself a target of that Shoot.

name: MEDIKIT
text: Patch up a friendly Pathfinder (never a drone) standing in this operative's control range: it gets back up to 2D3 lost wounds, to no more than its starting wounds. Anyone Medic! already saved this turning point cannot be treated. Unavailable in an enemy control range.

name: Group Activation
text: When this operative becomes expended, you must next activate another ready friendly Shas'la, if you have one, before your opponent activates. That Shas'la does not chain again, so never more than two in a row.

name: Fearless on the Frontline
text: Keeps marking targets with an enemy right on top of it (Markerlight is allowed in an enemy control range) and Falls Back for 1 AP less.

name: SYSTEM JAM
text: Pick an enemy operative this operative can see; it gets -1 APL until the end of its next activation. Not while this operative has a Conceal order or is in an enemy control range.

name: Multi-Dimensional Vision
text: Its sensors cut through haze and debris: no enemy counts as obscured against this operative's shots.

name: Drone
text: Drone: can only Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Markerlight, Reposition and Shoot, and only uses weapons on its own datacard. For objective control its APL counts as 1 lower (not an APL change). The round disc on top of the model is its head for visibility.

name: Drone
text: Drone: can only Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Reposition and Shoot, and only uses weapons on its own datacard. For objective control its APL counts as 1 lower (not an APL change). The round disc on top of the model is its head for visibility.

name: Drone
text: Drone: can only Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight and Reposition, and only uses weapons on its own datacard. For objective control its APL counts as 1 lower (not an APL change). The round disc on top of the model is its head for visibility.

name: Drone
text: Drone: can only Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Markerlight and Reposition, and only uses weapons on its own datacard. For objective control its APL counts as 1 lower (not an APL change). The round disc on top of the model is its head for visibility.

name: Drone
text: Drone: can only Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Pulse Accelerator and Reposition, and only uses weapons on its own datacard. For objective control its APL counts as 1 lower (not an APL change). The round disc on top of the model is its head for visibility.

name: Drone
text: Drone: can only Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight and Reposition, and only uses weapons on its own datacard. For objective control its APL counts as 1 lower (not an APL change). The round disc on top of the model is its head for visibility.

name: Analyse
text: Its wide-angle scanner spills over: a Markerlight from this drone also hands one token (cap 4 as usual) to each further enemy it can see within 3 inches of the one it picked. The Shoot and Markerlight same-target rule does not bind it.

name: Shield Generator
text: Weapons used against this drone lose Piercing, including Piercing Crits. Once per turning point, when an attack die would inflict Normal Dmg on it, ignore that damage. It can be the drone chosen for Saviour Protocols at no CP.

name: High-intensity Markerlight
text: Its beam is strong enough to mark twice: each Markerlight it makes puts a pair of tokens on the picked enemy (cap 4).

name: PULSE ACCELERATOR
text: The drone charges nearby pulse weapons: until it next activates or is taken out, any other friendly Pathfinder firing a pulse weapon (burst cannon, pulse carbine, suppressed or twin pulse carbine) from within 3 inches of it gains Lethal 5+ and Severe on that weapon.

name: Grav-inhibitor
text: A heavy gravity field: an enemy moving (other than by Dash) into a spot this drone can see within 6 inches pays 2 inches more for that action, though Obstructing and Accessible terrain then add nothing to it. An enemy this drone can see within 6 inches also fights and retaliates with its melee Hit 1 worse, stacking with injury.

name: PHOTON GRENADE
text: Once per turning point for the team, a Pathfinder with Markerlight on its datacard (not a drone) picks an enemy it can see and rolls a D6: on 3+, until the end of that enemy's next activation its Move is reduced by 2 inches (never below 4) and it cannot Dash. Not in an enemy control range, even for a Shas'la.
